item.title: 智能体编排：企业 AI 组织懂得如何治理智能体，却仍无法计量其成本
item.summary: Across 107 enterprises, agentic orchestration is not a choice of a single platform. The typical enterprise runs three orchestration platforms at once, and selects them for flexibility across models rather than affinity to any single one.
